card.title: How To Repair iPhone 12 Pro Max fake temperature warning

source.title: How To Repair iPhone 12 Pro Max fake temperature warning

symptoms: Temperature Too High warning while cool

claims.statement: A false Temperature warning on iPhone 12 Pro Max is usually a faulty charge port flex, or cracked joints between the AP and RF sandwich layers breaking RF temperature sensor lines.
For data recovery only, adding 10 kΩ to ground on interposer pin 487 (NTC_RADIO_BB_SE) and pin 489 (NTC_RADIO_PA_SE) forces valid readings long enough to back up.

procedure: Confirm phone is cool and idle draw normal.
Replace the charge port flex with OEM.
If persists, split and reball the RF layer.
For data only: bottom board in iSocket or 10 kΩ bypass resistors.

measurements.context: To ground on pins 487 and 489, data recovery only

cautions: SOURCE RISK: The resistor bypass is not a permanent repair.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
